notes.title: Latest Updates / Demo v66-76 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hello!

It's been a while and a lot of development has been happening! Still aiming to release the game in singleplayer early access this year, but there is a small chance it gets pushed into 2026. The biggest hurdle that remains is finishing gamepad support. To help ensure that the game releases soon, it would be a huge help if you helped playtest the early access game and contribute feedback, Join the Discord if you're interested! 

Below are all the latest patch notes for the demo. A fun little feature that I just pushed to the demo is chainable ziplines!


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44335689/885f78eed2f06c04be61a90da9ad007a993872de.gif"]



Skyformer Demo v66-v76 Patch Notes

Features:

Add chainable ziplines.

Support capital letters when typing in text boxes.

Building HP updates now show at a longer range.

Add a recipe viewer window in the drone view so you don't have to go to a factory to check the recipes.

Compass now shows a marker when an object is marked in the world during objective.

Add ability to delete items.

Input remapping: display existing control while remapping, and add a reset to defaults button.

Show cargo drone item delivery rates in various places.

Show predicted terraform rating before doing an operation. Also base the number of weather stations / drone platforms needed on the predicted terraform rating (allows undoing operations more easily).

New elevator model design and logic that prevents getting stuck.

Make the base temperature and storm display double-sided.

Deep ocean is now accessible to the player (instead of just getting blocked) but deals much more damage.

New horizontal FOV slider setting,

Grey background added to the sliding notifications (e.g. +1 Charged Gem) so that you can see it clearly in snowy areas.

Bugs:

Fix bug where charge didn't drain in skybase (related to doors and elevators).

Fix bugs where game crashes when you have more than 200 factories.

Fix bug with sounds when audio devices are disconnected/connected.

Fix bug where static noise would play during certain sound effects on certain machines.

Fix bug where the player location icon wasn't exactly at the player location on the map.

Fix bug with sound effect prioritization.

Several power plant bug fixes (related to their hp hitting zero).

Fix bug where sound volumes get changed to max after changing sound devices.

Other:

Reduce player bounding radius (player can now move through all the tight corners in the base).

Improve data center status UI text formatting.

Paginate sound devices screen.

Added numbers to the HP display.

Make the drone route viz show the route direction a little bit more clearly.

Better way of displaying detected resources (it's now a window with acknowledge button).

Indicate the name of the mined resource in the miner interface.

Plants and buildings continue to get re-used if using them from the hot bar.

New icons for all the gems in the game.

Display "no items left" when using an item in hot bar and you're out of items.

Add a helpful message when trying to repair building that has 0 hp.

Allow withdrawing individual items from rocket platform.

New little scene in the intro that shows the player, and fix sources of bugs when pressing different keys during the intro cutscene.

Dust Storm balance improvements.

Prevent UIs from being "opened" in the background in photo mode.

Change wording: "Configure Item (optional)" to "Restrict Item (optional)" in the drone route configuration screen to make more sense.

Mention sprint doesn't use extra charge + add sprint lock to displayed controls at game start.

Adjust the teleport angle when entering the HQ to be more convenient.

Revamped tutorial experience based on playtesting data: adjusted models, text, visualizations, etc!

Terrain edits to reduce the chance of getting lost in the demo.

Update the objectives with more detailed steps and better wording.

Fixed bug with ocean rendering after teleporting.

Reduce the amount of glow a bit when looking at drone route visuals.

Increase speed of drone you pilot in the Drone Control Tower.

Don't play ocean sound when water around you is frozen.

Improve the base building positioning algorithm when building below you in the skybase.

Fix Foundation Floor lighting issues.

Improved Windows Controlled Folder access denied detection when game starts up (will probably move all the save files to local AppData in the future instead of Documents).

Various UI improvements and small model adjustments.

Memory usage optimizations.

notes.title: Skyformer Demo v62-65 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Ability to pause the game

Fix issue that causes shadows to pop in and out when rotating camera near high terrain

Fix bug where buildings become unusable at zero health in certain situations

Shadow rendering distance increased 3x

Allow putting custom labels on logistical storage units and base storage units

Ocean graphics and performance improvements

Fix bug that prevented adding rockets to Rocket Launch Platform

Make recipes for basic base items a little cheaper

Reduce game size from 310MB to 175MB.

Update base door model to have a window and make transitions much faster when using base doors and elevators

Handle device disconnects/connects in the sound engine (previously it could cause the game to crash)

Fix bug where power drone animation plays even if power plant is not functioning

Allow crafting things when inventory is full but space is available

Fixed positioning issues with some plants in Planters

Reduced the chance of radioactive storms from Radioactive Gems

Show notifications that an item is pinned/unpinned

Update recipe for cargo drone and repair drone to require 1 computer T1 instead of 2 and increase copper wire requirement for computer T1 from 2 to 4

Construction station requirements are now pinnable

Ability to grid snap from the Drone View Constructor

The camera now interpolates to the rock you're mining instead of abruptly snapping

Improved some areas with messed up terrain

New weather observation tab in the weather map UI

Model borders are now slightly thicker

Server-side memory usage improvements

Fix bug where oceean temperatures are calculated incorrectly, leading to damage calculation issues

Fixed issue where game crashed in Simplified Chinese version

Small updates to various models and tiny polishes to UI



Join the Discord for more detailed updates, discussions, and upcoming playtests!

notes.title: Skyformer Demo v61 Patch
notes.content:
Fix issue where rebuilding planters caused several bugs.

Newly acquired items stack to the first matching item slot instead of the first empty slot.

Fix bug where some controls don't work after you die.

Reduced dust storm damage by 20%. Dust storms in the demo are just meant to show you the basics of how storms work and are not that interesting in terms of strategy. 

Fixed some rough spots in the terrain in various places.

Graphics work: slightly improved the shading for the terrain, especially for snowy/sandy areas.



Join the Discord for more detailed updates, discussions, and upcoming playtests!

notes.title: Upcoming playtesting, v60 update, and Japanese!
notes.content:
Hello again!



Wanted to share some of the recent updates on the development and playtesting - it's been a little bumpy so far this month because I've been moving. If you're new here from Automation Fest, welcome!

Just pushed a new inventory management update yesterday, allowing operations such as transferring all items of the same type, splitting items with custom amounts, and more. 

There's a mystery (along with a new storm type) in the demo that gets solved in the main game. 

Japanese language is now supported.

Gamepad support is in progress - will be coordinating playtesting in the Discord when ready. 


Full Game Playtesting
If you've played through the demo and provided feedback for it, you'll be eligible to playtest the full game soon! Join the Discord and I'll make announcements about signups for this soon. 



Thanks so much for the support and talk to you again soon!

notes.title: Demo & Roadmap
notes.content:
Hey everyone! 

Thank you so much for following my game. I want to share my latest roadmap: 

Current: Closed beta playtesting

 Join the Discord if you're interested in playing and helping out! 

March 2025: Public Steam demo playtest 

 There will be a "Request Access" button on the Steam Page for the playtest, and I'll be letting a limited number of people in to test and help ensure that the Demo is stable.

May 2025: Free Steam demo

June 2025: Steam Next Fest

August 2025: Early access singleplayer PC release

Through 2026: Multiple new maps and co-op multiplayer for full release

Stay in the loop

 Discord
 Youtube

Talk to you again soon, thanks!
